questions.explain: A cone is ⅓ of the cylinder.

questions.prompt: A solid is a hemisphere of radius r topped by a cone of the same radius. If the total height is 2r, show that the volume is πr³.
questions.modelAnswer: The cone’s height is 2r − r = r. Cone volume = ⅓πr² × r = ⅓πr³. Hemisphere volume = ⅔πr³. Total = ⅓πr³ + ⅔πr³ = πr³.
